save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with epoch, iteration, model state, optimizer state, and logger to an output location
restore_checkpoint: restore a model checkpoint from a saved file and reload model, optimizer, step, and logger state
save_callback_data_parallel: use save_checkpoint_callback to safely save checkpoints across parallel processes with a barrier synchronization
restore_with_module_prefix: restore a checkpoint and automatically handle module prefix differences between DataParallel and single GPU models
review_checkpointing: review the checkpointing module to understand save and restore logic for PyTorch model training state
